value.name: SHPE Industry Networking Night
value.description: Join us for SHPE Industry Networking Night, an evening focused on preparing students for the upcoming SHPE National Convention while building meaningful professional and SHPE connections. The event will include convention expectations and preparation tips, company introductions, and a speed networking session. Students will have the opportunity to connect with industry professionals and SHPE members from other schools in the region, explore different career paths, and strengthen their professional network.

value.name: Day in the Life (DITL) Speaker Series
value.description: Join the Computer Science Women's Network (CSWN) for our Day in the Life (DITL) speaker series! Each 30-minute virtual session features a different industry professional who shares what a typical day in their role looks like, their career journey, insights on working in technology, and advice for students exploring careers in tech. The event includes time for attendees to ask questions and connect with the speaker. Everyone is welcome to attend.

value.name: Weekly Badminton Club Hours
value.description:
Join the Purdue Indy Badminton Club for our weekly rec hours! Whether you're a seasoned player bringing your own racket, or you just want to casually rally with friends to de-stress, all skill levels are welcome to drop in.

 

This is a great way to stay active, meet other club members, and get consistent court time throughout the semester.

 

The Details:

 

- When: Mondays and Wednesdays, 9:00 PM - 11:00 PM

 

- Where: The Jungle / IUI Gymnasium

 

- What to Bring: Indoor court shoes, a water bottle, and your racket (club rackets available to borrow as well!)

 

Stay Connected:

 

- Discord: https://discord.gg/rbJQxVKVK

 

- Instagram: instagram.com/purdueindybadminton

 

See you on the court!

value.name: ME Fun Run
value.description:
Here's a revised version for a 1-mile fun run:

Purdue Mechanical Engineering Ambassadors 1-Mile Fun Run

Lace up your running shoes and join the Purdue Engineering community for a fun, non-competitive 1-mile run through campus! Whether you're a seasoned runner or just looking for a fun way to stay active, this event is open to students, faculty, staff, or friends!

The scenic one-mile course offers a chance to enjoy campus, connect with fellow Boilermakers, and celebrate the Engineering community in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Run, jog, or walk at your own pace—everyone is encouraged to participate.

value.name: Rocky Horror Picture Show
value.description:
An interactive movie experience of the campy cult-classic, The Rocky Horror Picture Show!! Attendees will be encouraged to dress up for the event and supply kits (typically rubber glove, noise maker, newspaper, etc) will be provided.

 

Before the showing we will have trivia, a costume contest, and games.
